story.step1_title:
The Perfect Nut,
Straight From The Source.
story.step1_desc: Every NovaNut begins in the world's finest orchards. We select only the highest-grade walnuts, still protected in their natural shells, ensuring maximum freshness and nutritional value before they even reach our facilities.
story.step2_desc: Our extraction process is fully sustainable. The shells are completely recycled for biomass energy, and every drop of water is reclaimed. We believe premium quality should not cost the earth.
story.step3_desc_p1: Nova Nut LLC was founded in 2005, with its core activity being the procurement, processing, and export of in-shell walnuts and walnut kernels. Our factory is equipped with modern walnut processing equipment and is located in the central region of the Republic of Moldova, just 15 km from the capital, Chisinau.
story.step3_desc_p2: Qualified and experienced staff, continuous development, advanced and modern processing, drying and packaging technologies, sanitary conditions meeting European Union and US standards, and a high-quality finished product—all these combined place our company among the most competitive enterprises in Central Europe in this sector.
story.step3_desc_p3: Nova Nut LLC offers premium quality products and has been certified organic since 2006, according to the following global ecological regulations: EU, NOP - USA, BioSuisse - Switzerland, KRAV - Sweden, and Naturland - Germany. The processing facility is certified IFS Food 6.1 and HACCP since 2006, as well as Kosher - USA.

products_catalog.page_subtitle: Our success is the result of our specialization
products_catalog.intro_text: Walnut kernels are among the healthiest foods you can consume daily, providing remarkable benefits for human health. Nova Nut LLC offers certified organic and conventional walnut kernels of superior, select, freshly processed quality, as well as in-shell walnuts harvested from the ecological regions of the Republic of Moldova.
products_catalog.quote_banner: We do not focus on a single-day business; we aspire to fruitful and long-lasting cooperation.
products_catalog.p1_desc: Light colored walnut halves with minimum 80-90% integrity. Premium standard for high-end retail and gourmet packaging.
products_catalog.p2_desc: Calibrated blend of light halves (20-70%) and large pieces, tailored precisely to customer requirements.
products_catalog.p3_desc: Light colored quarters and large pieces, ideal for bakery, chocolate confectionery, and dessert manufacturing.
products_catalog.p4_desc: Uniformly calibrated 15mm light pieces, perfect for premium snack mixes, granola, and bakeries.
products_catalog.p5_desc: Finely diced light pieces (4-8mm), excellent for ice cream toppings, energy bars, and pastry coatings.
products_catalog.p6_desc: Light Amber halves (80-90%) with intense roasted walnut aroma and high nutritional mineral density.
products_catalog.p7_desc: Versatile mixture of Light Amber halves and pieces for food service, catering, and culinary processing.
products_catalog.p8_desc: Selected Light Amber quarters and pieces, popular for ingredient blending, cookies, and baking.
products_catalog.p9_desc: Standardized 15mm Light Amber pieces for breakfast cereals, muesli, bars, and confectionery.
products_catalog.p10_desc: Robust walnut kernels for cold-press walnut oil, nut butters, pastes, and large-scale industrial processing.
products_catalog.p11_desc: 100% natural, finely ground gluten-free walnut flour, rich in clean plant protein and essential fatty acids.
products_catalog.p12_desc: Natural uncracked walnuts, thoroughly washed, dried, and graded by caliber (28mm, 30mm, 32mm+) from Moldovan orchards.
